recognize_zh: CD7 免疫染色中，密集淋巴球浸潤裡只有散在的部分細胞呈細胞膜陽性，大多數小到中型細胞為陰性（藍色）；在 T 細胞為主的病灶中出現大量 CD7 缺失，提示 T 細胞異常表型，常見於 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病。
features: Dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Membranous CD7 staining in scattered cells only, a minority of the infiltrate
Most lymphoid cells are CD7-negative despite a T-cell-predominant lesion
Positive cells are evenly distributed without zonation
Supports partial loss of CD7 expression
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD7 on a skin biopsy shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate in which only scattered cells show membranous staining, while the majority of small to medium-sized cells are negative. Given the T-cell predominance of the infiltrate on CD3, this indicates partial loss of CD7 expression. CD7 loss is a common aberrancy in cutaneous T-cell lymphoproliferations but is not specific, as it can also be seen in reactive dermatoses. Findings support an atypical T-cell population and are consistent with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder in context.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates can also show some CD7 loss, so separation relies on the clinical presentation, a mixed B/T composition and absence of a dominant clone rather than CD7 alone.
Mycosis fungoides also frequently loses CD7 but is epidermotropic with a patch/plaque history, unlike a solitary dermal nodule.
ATLL typically shows CD7 loss with CD25 positivity, HTLV-1 serology and flower cells in blood.
